text:
Maria Chen: Morning team — quick async check-in for ingress/routing/auth/rate limits.

Raj Patel: Done: rolled rate-limiter v2 to canary in us-west. Saw ~1% 429s after rollout.
Logs snippet:
```
[WARN] refill_delay=120ms bucket=api/ingest count=429
```

Liam O'Connor: PR -> https://git.redwood/ingress/pull/642. Fixes prefix routing edgecase; failing tests on auth header case.

Maria Chen: Blocker: jwt rotation repro in staging — auth returns 401 for tokens that should be accepted by fallback key. Repro command:
`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <stale_token>" -v https://ingress.staging.redwood/api/health`

Sarah Gomez: On it. Can we rollback the canary until root cause? :thinking: 

Raj Patel: I think rollback unnecessary — canary used new burst window by mistake. I'll flip to old-throttle-config now and recheck metrics. Pinging @Liam to update tests accordingly.

Liam O'Connor: ack. Updating PR to mirror old burst settings; also found a race in policy-evaluator cache on rule update, pushing a hotfix branch.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary config update applied by Raj. Build #5842 succeeded :white_check_mark:

Maria Chen: Thanks. Today: (1) help Sarah repro jwt rotation and collect traces, (2) add unit tests for policy cache eviction, (3) pair with Raj on metrics dashboard updates. No other blockers.

Tess (ops): FYI I'll relax the alert threshold for 429s by 20% for the next hour while we stabilize.

Raj Patel: Script to dump token-bucket state:
```
kubectl exec -it ingress-rate-ctl -- /bin/sh -c 'curl localhost:9090/buckets | jq . | grep myservice'
```

Maria Chen: :thumbsup: I'll run after config flip.

Liam O'Connor: Pinged reviewers (@Sarah @Maria). If no objections by EOD I'll merge the routing PR.

Sarah Gomez: LGTM and quick test pass. :thumbsup:
